note: Sky1 arm64 DEFAULT kernel under the unified 7.3 policy: r288 = first v7.3-rc7 port. Mechanical rebase of the 207-commit kernel-73rc6-port series onto v7.3-rc7 (no upstream conflict, 207 of 207 rebase cleanly), plus the drm/cix/dptx aux-wedge recovery v2 patch (fix/dptx-aux-wedge-recovery-v2-20261011, the dpfix session reviewed+built candidate from r286). This is a SHAPE-PRESERVING port: the r287 audio-cutout fix (CONFIG_RT_GROUP_SCHED=n) and the CIX q3 vendor sync (patches 0013-0021) are NOT in this build, per operator brief 2026-10-11 (vendor config options already used for 7.3-rc6 are kept; the O6N audio-cutout regression therefore persists on r288 and is a known carry-over to be addressed in a follow-up r289). Accelerator overlays (mali_kbase, memory_group_manager, protected_memory_allocator, panthor, aipu, amvx) are NOT rebuilt or re-mirrored in this branch - the KVER change from 7.3.0-rc6-sky1-ncz to 7.3.0-rc7-sky1-ncz will move exported-symbol CRCs and the existing r287 overlays will refuse to load. The image build pipeline MUST rebuild all six accelerator DKMS debs against r288 headers before any image ships, exactly the same operational requirement the r282->r284 and r285->r287 transitions each had. Staged at /mnt/argonas-yocto-shared/kernel-staging/r288-7.3.0-rc7-sky1-ncz-20261012. Replaced by 7.3.0 final later.
